text: 7月刚过10天，已有9家上市券商发布2026年半年度业绩预告，无一例外实现高增长，招商证券等更是直言经营业绩已创历史新高。具体来看，从绝对值计，中信证券、国泰海通双双净利润超200亿元；从增幅计，天风证券以最高693.5%的增幅领跑。更为亮眼的是，多家券商在第二季度实现业绩爆发，5家单季净利增幅翻倍。非银分析师研判，随着财报陆续披露，市场对2026年证券业务的预期差有望逐步修复，券商板块估值修复空间显著。（券商中国）
text_en: Just 10 days into July, 9 listed brokerages have released 2026 H1 earnings pre-announcements, all reporting high growth without exception. China Merchants Securities stated outright that operating results hit a record high. In absolute terms, CITIC Securities and Guotai Haitong both posted net profits exceeding RMB 20 billion. In growth terms, Tianfeng Securities led with a maximum increase of 693.5%. More notably, several brokerages saw Q2 earnings surge, with 5 posting single-quarter net profit growth of over 100%. Non-bank analysts suggest that as financial reports are gradually disclosed, market expectations for 2026 securities business are likely to be incrementally revised. The valuation recovery space for the broker sector is significant. (Securities China)
